recentItems.title: 90’s Heroes Special | Evergreen 90’s Telugu Songs | Chiranjeevi, Balakrishna | S.P.Balasubrahmanyam
recentItems.description:
Lahari Music Telugu Presents 90’s Heroes Special – Telugu Super Hit Songs, featuring evergreen and memorable songs from the golden era of Telugu cinema.

Enjoy timeless performances by legendary heroes like Chiranjeevi, Venkatesh, Balakrishna, Nagarjuna, Srikanth and Pawan Kalyan, along with popular heroines including Sridevi, Divya Bharti, Shobana, Meena, Nagma, Soundarya, Ramya Krishnan & Raasi.

This special collection features unforgettable songs from movies like Muta Mestri, Kshana Kshanam, Rowdy Alludu, Bangaru Bullodu, Abbayigaru, Gokulamlo Seetha, Pelli Sandadi, Allari Alludu and Sundarakanda, bringing back the magic and nostalgia of 90’s Telugu cinema.

The songs are beautifully rendered by legendary singers including S. P. Balasubrahmanyam, K. S. Chithra, and S. P. Sailaja, with memorable music composed by M. M. Keeravani, Raj-Koti, Bappi Lahiri & Koti .The timeless lyrics are penned by legendary lyricists including Veturi Sundararama Murthy, Sirivennela Seetharama Sastry and Bhuvana Chandra.

🎶 Relive the romance, melody, mass beats and unforgettable memories of the 90’s Telugu music era with this special collection of evergreen super hit songs.
